column1: # ACTION values commonly used by ZAP baseline: IGNORE, WARN, FAIL.
# Launch stance: no ignored rules without owner, expiry, and issue reference.

column3: Sec-Fetch-Dest/Mode/Site/User are browser-generated request headers; automated scanners (including ZAP) do not include them — this is not a server-side response-header defect. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1816

robots.txt and sitemap.xml are intentionally public and cacheable static crawler resources; the HTML entry point is served with Cache-Control: no-store via netlify.toml. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1816

CSP: script-src and style-src unsafe-inline are required by the React/Vite SPA build; Stripe JS requires script-src and frame-src allowlists. Tightened: frame-ancestors 'self', worker-src 'none', and img-src restricted to Supabase domains. Removing unsafe-inline requires a full nonce/hash migration. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834

COEP (Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy) cannot be set to require-corp and COOP cannot be set to same-origin without breaking Stripe popup payment flows; current values (unsafe-none / same-origin-allow-popups) are intentional. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834

Permissions-Policy header is set for all our paths via netlify.toml but Netlify's own system path /.netlify/scripts/rum is served by Netlify Edge infrastructure outside our header configuration. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834

X-Content-Type-Options is set for all our paths via netlify.toml but Netlify's own system path /.netlify/scripts/rum is served by Netlify Edge infrastructure outside our header configuration. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834

Base64 strings detected in minified/bundled JavaScript assets are false positives — they are encoded binary data embedded by the bundler (e.g. font subsets, inline SVG), not server-generated secrets or tokens. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834
Retrieved from Cache is informational; responses served from Netlify CDN edge cache are expected and desired behaviour. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834

robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and driver-pwa/manifest.json are static public resources with explicit Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 set in netlify.toml; no sensitive data is cached. Ref: https://github.com/Infaemous-Freight/Infamous-freight/issues/1834
